Package edu.cnu.mdi.container

Interface IContainer

All Known Implementing Classes:
BaseContainer, MapContainer
public interface IContainer
A 2D drawing container with a world coordinate system and conversion to pixel (screen) coordinates. Implementations are typically Swing components that render one or more IDrawables.

    • getAnnotationLayer

      Layer getAnnotationLayer()
      Get the annotation layer for this container.
      Returns:
      the annotation layer for this container. All drawing tools draw on the annotation layer, which is kept on top.

    • getConnectionLayer

      Layer getConnectionLayer()
      Get the connection layer for this container.
      Returns:
      the connection layer for this container. Connection items are drawn on first, i.e. connections are under other items.

      Returns:
      the z layer, or null.
